title: ePWM
text: 生成增强型脉宽调制（ePWM）波形；按 {Synchronization action} 指定相位偏移的来源；{Allow use of 16 HRPWMs (for C28044) instead of 6 PWMs} 指定当 PWM 分辨率过低时启用 HRPWM、{Module} 指示要使用的 ePWM 模块、{ePWMLink TBPRD} 指示 ePWM 模块的 TBPRD 链接 Not、{Timer period units} 指示时间周期单位 Clock、{Specify timer period via} 指定配置定时器周期值的来源 Specify via、{Timer period} 指示 ePWM 计数器的周期、{Timer initial period} 指示波形的初始 ePWM 周期、{Active period register load option (PRDLD)} 指定重新加载计数器周期寄存器时的事件 Counter equals、{Counting mode} 指示 ePWM 计数器的计数模式、{Counting direction after phase synchronization} 指定相位同步后的计数器方向 Count down after、{Phase offset value (TBPHS)}、{Specify software synchronization via input port (SWFSYNC)} 指示相位偏移值、{Enable digital compare A event1 synchronization (DCAEVT1)} 指定基于 DCAEVT1 数字比较事件同步 ePWM、{Enable digital compare B event1 synchronization (DCBEVT1)} 指定基于 DCBEVT1 数字比较事件同步 ePWM、{Synchronization output (SYNCO)} 指定生成时基同步输出信号的事件、{Peripheral synchronization event (PWMSYNCSEL)} 指定时基计数器外设同步 Counter equals、{Time base clock (TBCLK) prescaler divider} 指定对应于 CLKDIV 的时基时钟、{High speed time base clock (HSPCLKDIV) prescaler divider} 指定高速时基时钟、{Enable swap module A and B} 指定交换模块 A 和 B 的输出信号、{Enable ePWM#x} 启用 ePWMx 输出信号、{Action when counter=ZERO, Action when counter=period (PRD), Action when counter=CMPA on up-count (CAU), Action when counter=CMPA on down-count (CAD), Action when counter=CMPB on up-count (CBU), Action when counter=CMPB on down-count (CBD)} 确定动作限定器、{Add continuous software force input port, Continuous software force logic, Reload condition for software force} 确定动作限定器、{Inverted version of ePWM#A} 指定反转 ePWM#A 信号、{Enable high resolution PWM (HRPWM)} 启用高分辨率 PWM 设置、{ePWMLink CMPx} 指定 ePWM 模块的链接 Not、{CMPx Units} 指定比较寄存器使用的单位 Clock、{Specify CMPx Via} 指定脉冲宽度源 Specify via、{CMPx Value/CMPx Initial Value} 指定脉冲宽度值、{Reload for compare x Register (SHDWxMODE)} 指定计数器周期复位的时间 Counter equals、{Use deadband for ePWM#A, Use deadband for ePWM#B} 启用死区、{Enable half-cycle clocking} 指定双倍死区分辨率、{Deadband Polarity} 指定死区时间内的 ePWM 输出状态 Active、{Signal source for rising edge (RED)} 指定上升沿源 ePWMxA、{Signal source for falling edge (FED)} 指定下降沿源 ePWMxA、{Deadband period units} 指示死区周期单位 Clock、{Deadband period source} 控制逻辑源 Specify via、{Deadband Rising edge (RED) period (0-16383)} 指定 RED 延迟时间值、{Deadband Falling edge (FED) period} 指定 FED 延迟时间值、{Reload for DBRED register (SHDWDBRED), Reload for DBFED register (SHDWDBFED)} 指定将影子寄存器传送到活动寄存器所对应的事件 Immediate without using、{Enable ADC start of conversion for module A} 指定 ADC 转换开始事件、{Number of event for start of conversion for Module A (SOCA) to be generated} 指定事件起始编号 First、{Start of conversion for module A event selection} 指示触发 ADC 转换开始事件的计数器匹配条件 Counter equals、{Enable ADC start of conversion for module B} 指定 ADC 转换开始事件、{Number of event for start of conversion for Module B (SOCB) to be generated} 指定事件起始编号 First、{Start of conversion for module B event selection} 指示触发 ADC 转换开始事件的计数器匹配条件 Counter equals、{Enable ePWM interrupt} 指定生成 ePWM 中断、{Number of event for interrupt to be generated} 指定触发 ePWM 中断的事件数、{Interrupt counter match event condition} 指示触发 ePWM 中断的计数器匹配条件 Counter equals、{Enable High Resolution Period on ePWM#A (HRPWM - period), Enable High Resolution Period on ePWM#B (HRPWM - period)} 指示常规生成的 PWM 的有效分辨率、{Enable HRPWM Duty on ePWM#A(HRPWM - duty)} 指示比较值的小数部分、{High resolution PWM (HRPWM) Load mode on ePWM#A} 确定何时将 CMPAHR 影子值传送到活动寄存器 Counter equals、{High resolution PWM (HRPWM) control mode on ePWM#A} 指示控制模式 Duty control、{High resolution PWM (HRPWM) edge control mode} 指示边沿控制模式 Both、{Enable high resolution deadband rising edge (RED), Enable high resolution deadband falling edge (FED)} 指定在死区上升沿延迟和下降沿延迟上启用 HRPWM 功能、{Use scale factor optimizer (SFO) software} 表示比例因子、{Enable auto convert} 表示自动转换、{Chopper module enable} 启用斩波模块、{Chopper frequency divider} 确定斩波时钟的频率、{Chopper clock cycles width of first pulse} 用于快速硬开通功率开关的高能量首个脉冲、{Chopper pulse duty cycle} 确定第二个及后续脉冲的占空比、{Trip zone source} 确定跳闸区信号控制逻辑的来源 Specify via、{Enable one-shot Trip-zone# (TZ#)} 指定在单次模式下启用对应的跳闸区信号、{Enable one-shot digital compare A event 1 (DCAEVT1), Enable one-shot digital compare B event 1 (DCBEVT1)} 启用对应事件信号作为事件 1 的 OST 跳闸源、{Enable cyclic Trip-zone# (TZ#)} 指定在逐周期模式下启用对应的跳闸区信号、{Enable cyclic digital compare A event 2 (DCAEVT2), Enable cyclic digital compare B event 2 (DCBEVT2)} 启用对应事件信号作为事件 2 的循环跳闸源、{Enable trip-zone one-shot interrupt (OST)} 指定使能跳变区单次中断、{Enable trip-zone cycle-by-cycle interrupt (CBC)} 指定使能跳变区逐周期中断、{Digital comparator output A event 1 interrupt enable (DCAEVT1), Digital comparator output A event 2 interrupt enable (DCAEVT2), Digital comparator output B event 1 interrupt enable (DCBEVT1), Digital comparator output B event 2 interrupt enable (DCBEVT2)} 指定使能数字比较器输出、{Clear cycle-by-cycle trip latch at} 指定清除逐周期跳变锁存 Counter equals、{ePWM#A forced (TZ) to, ePWM#B forced (TZ) to, ePWM#A forced (DCAEVT#) to, ePWM#B forced (DCBEVT#) to} 确定要对 ePWM 输出考虑的操作 No、{Source for digital compare A high signal (DCAH), Source for digital compare B high signal (DCBH)} 指定数字比较高信号的源 GPTRIP1SEL/、{Source for digital compare A low signal (DCAL), Source for digital compare B low signal (DCBL)} 指定数字比较低信号的源 GPTRIP1SEL/、{Digital compare output A event # selection (DCAEVT#), Digital Compare output B event # selection (DCBEVT#)} 指定限定生成 DC 事件的信号 Event、{DCAEVT# source select, DCBEVT# source select} 指定数字比较事件源 Event、{Pulse select} 指示用于滤除事件发生的消隐窗口 Counter equals、{Blanking window inverted} 指示反相消隐窗口、{Blanking window offset} 指示消隐窗口偏移、{Blanking window width} 指示消隐窗口的持续时间、{Filter output DCEVTFILT} 指示滤波器的源选择 Filtered version、{Enable counter capture} 指示计数器捕获，按实例取值。

params.name: Allow use of 16 HRPWMs (for C28044) instead of 6 PWMs
params.values: 当 PWM 分辨率过低时启用 HRPWM off (default) | on

params.name: Module
params.values: 指示要使用的 ePWM 模块 ePWM1 (default) | ePWM2 | ePWM3 | …

params.name: ePWMLink TBPRD
params.values: 指示 ePWM 模块的 TBPRD 链接 Not Linked (default) | ePWM2 | ePWM3 | …

params.name: Timer period units
params.values: 指示时间周期单位 Clock cycles (default) | Seconds

params.name: Specify timer period via
params.values: 配置定时器周期值的来源 Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Timer period
params.values: 指示 ePWM 计数器的周期 64000 (default)

params.name: Timer initial period
params.values: 指示波形的初始 ePWM 周期 64000 (default) | 0 |...

params.name: Active period register load option (PRDLD)
params.values: 重新加载计数器周期寄存器时的事件 Counter equals to zero (default) | Counter equals to zero or SYNC event | SYNC event | Immediate without using shadow

params.name: Counting mode
params.values: 指示 ePWM 计数器的计数模式 Up-Down (default) | Up | Down

params.name: Synchronization action
params.values: 指定相位偏移的来源 Disable (default) | Set counter to phase value specified via dialog | Set counter to phase value specified via input port

params.name: Counting direction after phase synchronization
params.values: 相位同步后的计数器方向 Count down after sync (default) | Count up after sync

params.name: Phase offset value (TBPHS)
params.values: 指定 Phase offset value (TBPHS) 0 (default)

params.name: Specify software synchronization via input port (SWFSYNC)
params.values: 指示相位偏移值 off (default) | on

params.name: Enable digital compare A event1 synchronization (DCAEVT1)
params.values: 基于 DCAEVT1 数字比较事件同步 ePWM 时间 off (default) | on

params.name: Enable digital compare B event1 synchronization (DCBEVT1)
params.values: 基于 DCBEVT1 数字比较事件同步 ePWM 时间 off (default) | on

params.name: Synchronization output (SYNCO)
params.values: 生成时基同步输出信号的事件 Disable (default) | Pass through (EPWMxSYNCI or SWFSYNC) | Counter equals to zero (CTR=Zero) | Counter equals to compare B (CTR=CMPB) | Counter equals to compare C (CTR=CMPC) | Counter equals to compare D (CTR=CMPD) | Enable DCBEVT1 sync event to SYNCO signal | Enable DCAEVT1 sync event to SYNCO signal | Enable counter equals to compare D (CTR=CMPD) event to set SYNCO signal | Enable counter equals to compare C (CTR=CMPC) event to set SYNCO signal | Enable counter equals to compare B (CTR=CMPB) event to set SYNCO signal | Enable counter equals to zero (CTR=ZERO) event to set SYNCO signal | Enable SWFSYNC event to set SYNCO signal

params.name: Peripheral synchronization event (PWMSYNCSEL)
params.values: 时基计数器外设同步 Counter equals to period (CTR=PRD) (default) | Counter equals to zero (CTR=Zero) | Counter is incrementing and equals to compare C register (CTRU=CMPC) | Counter is decrementing and equals to compare C register (CTRD=CMPC) | Counter is incrementing and equals to compare D register (CTRU=CMPD) | Counter is decrementing and equals to compare D register (CTRD=CMPD)

params.name: Time base clock (TBCLK) prescaler divider
params.values: 对应于 CLKDIV 的时基时钟 (TBCLK) 预分频器分频值 1 (default) | 2 | 4 | …

params.name: High speed time base clock (HSPCLKDIV) prescaler divider
params.values: 高速时基时钟 (HSPCLKDIV) 预分频器分频值 1 (default) | 2 | 4 |...

params.name: Enable swap module A and B
params.values: 交换模块 A 和 B 的输出信号 off (default) | on

params.name: Enable ePWM#x
params.values: 启用 ePWMx 输出信号 off (default) | on

params.name: Action when counter=ZERO, Action when counter=period (PRD), Action when counter=CMPA on up-count (CAU), Action when counter=CMPA on down-count (CAD), Action when counter=CMPB on up-count (CBU), Action when counter=CMPB on down-count (CBD)
params.values: 确定动作限定器 (AQ) 子模块的行为 Set (default)

params.name: Add continuous software force input port, Continuous software force logic, Reload condition for software force
params.values: 确定动作限定器 (AQ) 子模块如何处理 S/W 强制事件 Load on counter equals to zero (CTR=Zero) (default)

params.name: Inverted version of ePWM#A
params.values: 反转 ePWM#A 信号 off (default) | on

params.name: Enable high resolution PWM (HRPWM)
params.values: 启用高分辨率 PWM 设置 off (default) | on

params.name: ePWMLink CMPx
params.values: ePWM 模块的链接 Not Linked (default) | ePWM1 | ePWM2 |...

params.name: CMPx Units
params.values: 比较寄存器使用的单位 Clock cycles (default) | Percentages

params.name: Specify CMPx Via
params.values: 脉冲宽度源 Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: CMPx Value/CMPx Initial Value
params.values: 脉冲宽度值 32000 (default)

params.name: Reload for compare x Register (SHDWxMODE)
params.values: 计数器周期复位的时间 Counter equals to zero (CTR=Zero) (default) | Counter equals to period (CTR=PRD) | Counter equals to Zero or period (CTR=Zero or CTR=PRD) |...

params.name: Use deadband for ePWM#A, Use deadband for ePWM#B
params.values: 启用死区 off (default) | on

params.name: Enable half-cycle clocking
params.values: 双倍死区分辨率 off (default) | on

params.name: Deadband Polarity
params.values: 死区时间内的 ePWM 输出状态 Active high (AH) (default) | Active low (AL) | Active high complementary (AHC) | Active low complementary (ALC)

params.name: Signal source for rising edge (RED)
params.values: 上升沿源 ePWMxA (default) | ePWMxB

params.name: Signal source for falling edge (FED)
params.values: 下降沿源 ePWMxA (default) | ePWMxB

params.name: Deadband period units
params.values: 指示死区周期单位 Clock cycles (default) | Seconds

params.name: Deadband period source
params.values: 控制逻辑源 Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Deadband Rising edge (RED) period (0-16383)
params.values: RED 延迟时间值 0 (default)

params.name: Deadband Falling edge (FED) period
params.values: FED 延迟时间值 0 (default)

params.name: Reload for DBRED register (SHDWDBRED), Reload for DBFED register (SHDWDBFED)
params.values: 将影子寄存器传送到活动寄存器所对应的事件 Immediate without using shadow (default) | Freeze | Counter equals to zero (CTR=Zero) | Counter equals to period (CTR=PRD) | Counter equals to either zero or period (CTR=Zero or CTR=PRD) |...

params.name: Enable ADC start of conversion for module A
params.values: ADC 转换开始事件 off (default) | on

params.name: Number of event for start of conversion for Module A (SOCA) to be generated
params.values: 事件起始编号 First event (default) | Second event | Third event |...

params.name: Start of conversion for module A event selection
params.values: 指示触发 ADC 转换开始事件的计数器匹配条件 Counter equals to zero (CTR=Zero) (default) | Digital Compare Module A Event 1 start of conversion (DCAEVT1.soc) |...

params.name: Enable ADC start of conversion for module B
params.values: ADC 转换开始事件 off (default) | on

params.name: Number of event for start of conversion for Module B (SOCB) to be generated
params.values: 事件起始编号 First event (default) | Second event | Third event |...

params.name: Start of conversion for module B event selection
params.values: 指示触发 ADC 转换开始事件的计数器匹配条件 Counter equals to zero (CTR=Zero) (default) |

params.name: Enable ePWM interrupt
params.values: 生成 ePWM 中断 Disabled (default) | Enabled

params.name: Number of event for interrupt to be generated
params.values: 指定触发 ePWM 中断的事件数 First event (default) | Second event to fifteenth event

params.name: Interrupt counter match event condition
params.values: 指示触发 ePWM 中断的计数器匹配条件 Counter equals to zero (CTR=Zero) (default)

params.name: Enable High Resolution Period on ePWM#A (HRPWM - period), Enable High Resolution Period on ePWM#B (HRPWM - period)
params.values: 指示常规生成的 PWM 的有效分辨率 off (default) | on

params.name: Enable HRPWM Duty on ePWM#A(HRPWM - duty)
params.values: 指示比较值的小数部分 off (default) | on

params.name: High resolution PWM (HRPWM) Load mode on ePWM#A
params.values: 确定何时将 CMPAHR 影子值传送到活动寄存器 Counter equals to period (CTR=PRD) (default) | Counter equals to zero (CTR=ZERO) | Counter equals to either zero or period (CTR=ZERO or CTR=PRD)

params.name: High resolution PWM (HRPWM) control mode on ePWM#A
params.values: 指示控制模式 Duty control mode (default) | Phase control mode

params.name: High resolution PWM (HRPWM) edge control mode
params.values: 指示边沿控制模式 Both Edge (default) | Rising Edge | Falling Edge

params.name: Enable high resolution deadband rising edge (RED), Enable high resolution deadband falling edge (FED)
params.values: 在死区上升沿延迟和下降沿延迟上启用 HRPWM 功能 off (default) | on

params.name: Use scale factor optimizer (SFO) software
params.values: 表示比例因子 off (default) | on

params.name: Enable auto convert
params.values: 表示自动转换 off (default) | on

params.name: Chopper module enable
params.values: 启用斩波模块 off (default) | on

params.name: Chopper frequency divider
params.values: 确定斩波时钟的频率 1 (default) | 2 |...

params.name: Chopper clock cycles width of first pulse
params.values: 用于快速硬开通功率开关的高能量首个脉冲 1 (default) | 2 |...

params.name: Chopper pulse duty cycle
params.values: 确定第二个及后续脉冲的占空比 12.5% (default) | 25% |...

params.name: Trip zone source
params.values: 确定跳闸区信号控制逻辑的来源 Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Enable one-shot Trip-zone# (TZ#)
params.values: 在单次模式下启用对应的跳闸区信号 off (default) | on

params.name: Enable one-shot digital compare A event 1 (DCAEVT1), Enable one-shot digital compare B event 1 (DCBEVT1)
params.values: 启用对应事件信号作为事件 1 的 OST 跳闸源 off (default) | on

params.name: Enable cyclic Trip-zone# (TZ#)
params.values: 在逐周期模式下启用对应的跳闸区信号 off (default) | on

params.name: Enable cyclic digital compare A event 2 (DCAEVT2), Enable cyclic digital compare B event 2 (DCBEVT2)
params.values: 启用对应事件信号作为事件 2 的循环跳闸源 off (default) | on

params.name: Enable trip-zone one-shot interrupt (OST)
params.values: 使能跳变区单次中断 off (default) | on

params.name: Enable trip-zone cycle-by-cycle interrupt (CBC)
params.values: 使能跳变区逐周期中断 off (default) | on

params.name: Digital comparator output A event 1 interrupt enable (DCAEVT1), Digital comparator output A event 2 interrupt enable (DCAEVT2), Digital comparator output B event 1 interrupt enable (DCBEVT1), Digital comparator output B event 2 interrupt enable (DCBEVT2)
params.values: 使能数字比较器输出 off (default) | on

params.name: Clear cycle-by-cycle trip latch at
params.values: 选择清除逐周期跳变锁存 Counter equals to zero (CTR=Zero) (default) | Counter equals to period (CTR=Prd) | Counter equals to zero or period (CTR=Zero or CTR=Prd) | Latch not cleared

params.name: ePWM#A forced (TZ) to, ePWM#B forced (TZ) to, ePWM#A forced (DCAEVT#) to, ePWM#B forced (DCBEVT#) to
params.values: 确定要对 ePWM 输出考虑的操作 No action (default) | High | Low | Hi-Z (High Impedance)

params.name: Source for digital compare A high signal (DCAH), Source for digital compare B high signal (DCBH)
params.values: 数字比较高信号的源 GPTRIP1SEL/(TZ1) for DCAH/GPTRIP1SEL/(TZ1) for DCBH (default) | GPTRIP3SEL/(TZ3) for DCAH/GPTRIP7SEL for DCBH |...

params.name: Source for digital compare A low signal (DCAL), Source for digital compare B low signal (DCBL)
params.values: 数字比较低信号的源 GPTRIP1SEL/(TZ1) for DCAL/GPTRIP1SEL/(TZ1) for DCBL (default) | TRIPIN1(ECCDBLERR) for DCAL/Select From DCBLTRIPSEL for DCBL |...

params.name: Digital compare output A event # selection (DCAEVT#), Digital Compare output B event # selection (DCBEVT#)
params.values: 限定生成 DC 事件的信号 Event disabled (default) | DCAH=low and DCAL=don’t care/DCBH=low and DCBL=don’t care |...

params.name: DCAEVT# source select, DCBEVT# source select
params.values: 数字比较事件源 Event disabled (default) | DCAH=low and DCAL=don’t care/DCBH=low and DCBL=don’t care |...

params.name: Pulse select
params.values: 指示用于滤除事件发生的消隐窗口 Counter equals to zero (CTR=Zero) (default) | Counter equals to period (CTR=PRD)

params.name: Blanking window inverted
params.values: 指示反相消隐窗口 off (default) | on

params.name: Blanking window offset
params.values: 指示消隐窗口偏移 0 (default)

params.name: Blanking window width
params.values: 指示消隐窗口的持续时间 0 (default)

params.name: Filter output DCEVTFILT
params.values: 指示滤波器的源选择 Filtered version of DCAEVT1 (DCAEVT1FILT) (default) | Filtered version of DCAEVT2 (DCAEVT2FILT) | Filtered version of DCBEVT1 (DCBEVT1FILT) | Filtered version of DCBEVT2 (DCBEVT2FILT)

params.name: Enable counter capture
params.values: 指示计数器捕获 off (default) | on
